summary: Iteration 2 fix verification: (1) Home tab quick-action tiles Income/Expense/Transfer/Reports render on a single line — VERIFIED (no wrap/broken chars). (2) FAB moved to bottom:24 sits ~24px above tab bar — VERIFIED positionally (fab bbox y=519-575, viewport 375x667, tab bar occupies bottom ~67px), no longer visually cluttering the Recent section title area. (3) Wallet CRUD: tapping a wallet card navigates to /wallet/[id] Edit screen; screen renders Current balance card, prefilled Name / Type chips / Balance, trash icon in header and 'Save changes' button — VERIFIED. Editing name (Main Bank -> Main Bank Updated) and balance ($3200 -> $5000) then Save navigates back and the Wallets card reflects new values (total updated $3450 -> $5250). (4) Backend PATCH /api/wallets/{id} still works — 3 new pytest cases pass (balance change, name+type change, unauth guard). Existing 31 backend tests still green. LIMITATION: Delete confirmation via Alert.alert cannot be exercised on the web preview because react-native-web's Alert.alert with multiple buttons is effectively a no-op (no dialog fires and no button callback runs). DELETE /api/wallets/{id} endpoint itself is verified passing in the backend suite. On native (iOS/Android) Alert.alert works, but for testability/parity the main agent may want to replace Alert.alert with a custom in-app Modal.

ui_bugs.issue: Uses React Native Alert.alert with multiple buttons which is a no-op on react-native-web (used by Expo web preview). Delete confirmation never appears and DELETE API is never called from web preview. Works on native. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallets.tsx:117-122 and /app/frontend/app/wallet/[id].tsx:62-70.

issues: FAB (bottom:24, right:xl) can still visually overlap the horizontally-scrollable filter chip row when the Recent section is at the top of the viewport (fresh account with 0 transactions). Consider bottom padding on the last content block or moving FAB up ~12px when at empty state. Non-blocking, mostly cosmetic on an empty ledger.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert with 2+ buttons is a no-op on web. Recommend a custom Modal for delete-confirm to maintain web parity. Reference: /app/frontend/app/wallet/[id].tsx:62 and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallets.tsx:117

Console warnings observed: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. These come from RN 0.76+ deprecations. Not blocking but should be addressed. Reference: multiple UI components emit these.

action_items: Replace Alert.alert delete-confirmation in /app/frontend/app/wallet/[id].tsx (remove()) and /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/wallets.tsx (confirmDelete()) with a cross-platform custom Modal so delete flows are testable and work on Expo web preview.
(Optional/cosmetic) Add extra bottom padding or hide FAB when Recent section is empty to avoid the FAB visually overlaying the filter chip row on empty ledgers.
(Optional) Migrate shadow* styles to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN deprecation warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Edit Wallet screen loads wallet by calling api.wallets() and searching client-side. This is fine for small lists but consider GET /api/wallets/{id} for O(1) lookup.
Balance input parses parseFloat(balance) || 0 — an empty string silently becomes 0 which will wipe out balance if a user clears the field. Add a guard or use current balance as default when empty.
wallets.tsx long-press delete confirmation duplicates logic in EditWallet.remove(). Consider extracting to a shared helper.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (UI fixes verified, edit/save CRUD verified; delete verified only at API level due to react-native-web Alert limitation)

seed_data_creation: Fresh signup users test+<epoch>@matrix.dev via /api/auth/signup, which auto-seeds Cash ($250) and Main Bank ($3200) wallets. Wallet edits/deletes performed against these are ephemeral per test user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wallet CRUD tap-to-edit flow works end-to-end for read/update. Delete flow requires custom Modal to be testable on web; backend DELETE is fine. Home tab UI fixes (single-line labels, FAB above tab bar) both verified. Screenshots at /tmp/03_home.png, /tmp/06_edit_wallet.png, /tmp/07_after_save.png.
rca_of_issue: The delete confirmation not firing on web preview is due to react-native-web's Alert.alert only supporting a single-button alert; with multiple buttons it becomes a no-op (documented behavior). Native builds are unaffected. Recommendation: implement a cross-platform confirm Modal.
